# Guillaume Gustin

> Guillaume Gustin is a Brussels-based IT Business Analyst with a software engineering
> background. He helps mission-driven organisations translate their needs into pragmatic
> digital solutions: eHealth platforms, public-sector services, GIS tools, and responsible
> AI. Biomedical engineer trained at UCLouvain.

Guillaume Gustin is an IT business analyst and software engineer based in Brussels,
Belgium. He began in biomedical engineering at UCLouvain, where software became a way
to make health systems more useful to people. Over 10 years in ICT, he has built
patient-monitoring tools, co-founded the medtech startup MedC2, supported non-profits
through digital transformation, and contributed to public-sector platforms. He focuses
on functional analysis, product discovery and solution design, with a growing emphasis
on responsible AI, and stays hands-on when useful — from prototype to production.

He runs Pwablo (https://pwablo.be), a sustainable web studio.

## Current role

- Functional Analyst & Software Engineer at Gate 16 (October 2025–present) — GIS web
  solutions for Brussels Mobility; R&D on RAG systems and agentic AI.

## Background

- Research Software Engineer, Vrije Universiteit Brussel (2025–2026) — analytics dashboard
  for the Ghostly rehabilitation study.
- Founder & Web Designer, Pwablo (2022–present) — sustainable web agency.
- Digital Transformation Advisor, BRUXEO (2022–2024) — supporting non-profits.
- Co-founder & Lead Developer, MedC2 / The Medical Cloud Company (2019–2021) — ePRO
  platforms and patient decision aids for cancer care; later acquired by Comunicare.
- Research & Teaching Assistant, UCLouvain Telecommunication Lab (2017–2019) — diabetes
  remote monitoring system (FEDER-funded).

## Notable contributions

- First author, "Empowerment of diabetic patients through mHealth technologies and
  education" (SIPAIM 2017) — cited 9 times.
- Contributed to the DRAGON EU grant application that secured €860,000 from the European
  Commission for MedC2 (COVID-19 AI tools, 2020).

## Expertise

IT business analysis, functional analysis, product discovery, solution design,
full-stack web development (React, Astro, Ionic, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Python,
n8n, PostgreSQL, Supabase), AI engineering (RAG systems, agentic AI, LLM
integration, AI governance), responsible IT (eco-design, digital sobriety, GDPR),
digital health and patient-reported outcomes, GIS platforms, public-sector
services, non-profit digital transformation, and biomedical engineering.

## Published Research

- "GHOSTLY+ Serious Game-Based Exercise for Upper Limb Rehabilitation After Stroke:
  Feasibility Study" — JMIR Serious Games (2025). https://doi.org/10.2196/69400
- "Empowerment of diabetic patients through mHealth technologies and education"
  — SIPAIM 2017. Cited 9 times.

## Education

- Master in Biomedical Engineering (Bioinformatics), UCLouvain — Cum Laude (2016).
- Bachelor in Biomedical & Computer Sciences, UCLouvain (2014).
- MIT Global Startup Labs — Entrepreneurship & Innovation (2018).
